stem.text: The enzyme invertase catalyses the breakdown of sucrose to glucose and fructose.
Three different enzyme inhibitors of invertase X, Y and Z were investigated. The percentage inhibition of invertase was measured at different concentrations of inhibitor.
The graph shows the result of the investigation.

stem.alt: Line graph of percentage inhibition against inhibitor concentration in arbitrary units, from 0 to 8, with three curves labelled inhibitor X, inhibitor Y and inhibitor Z.

stem.text: Which are valid conclusions from these results?

items: The higher the concentration of inhibitor X, the less sucrose is broken down.
The production of glucose and fructose using inhibitor Y is higher than when inhibitor Z is used.
The production of glucose and fructose at an inhibitor concentration of 2 arbitrary units is lower than at an inhibitor concentration of 4 arbitrary units, for all inhibitors.
